### Pull Request Motivation

Similar to what external-dns will be doing here: [https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/4958](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/4958),

There's common cloud/infra environment metadata that has to be repeated again and again over the values of different env like project/account ids, regions, etc. We want to leverage things like workload identity in GKE or IRSA …

ones I already mentioned.

This adds the ability to do things like:

```yaml
serviceAccount:
annotations:
iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account: "cert-manager@{{ .Values.metadata.gcpProject }}.iam.gserviceaccount"
```

Where the project is dynamically passed by our deployment tooling so we don't have to repeat this value again and again.
